svg.title: Recovery coverage across the sample window
svg.desc: A timeline from 2026-08-01T00:00Z to 2026-08-04T18:00Z. An amber band marks the leading gap from 00:00 to 06:00 where no full backup exists to restore from. Backups are drawn as ticks. The widest gap between recovery points, 27 hours from the orphaned incremental to the next full, is marked in teal and exceeds the declared 24 hour objective.
